mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate compresses discount rates for equity valuation, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as the monetary policy easing cycle progresses.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS is declining, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate falls below 0.25%, it signals an ultra-low interest rate environment that stimulates equity demand, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when FEDFUNDS < 0.25%, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous expansion in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) signals robust consumer demand and economic activity, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days through improved corporate earnings expectations.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when both HOUST and RSAFS are above their 3-month moving averages, or the Rank IC for the interaction term is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: In high unemployment regimes (UNRATE > 5.5%), economic slack suppresses corporate profit growth and increases recession risk, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when UNRATE > 5.5%, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: A rising industrial production index (INDPRO) indicates expanding manufacturing output and economic activity, which supports corporate earnings growth and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when INDPRO is rising, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) exceed 1200 thousand units, it signals strong residential construction activity and consumer confidence, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when HOUST > 1200.0, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: In low inflation regimes (CPIAUCSL < 240), the central bank maintains accommodative monetary policy, supporting equity valuations and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when CPIAUCSL < 240, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) exceeds 105.0, it indicates strong manufacturing output growth, boosting corporate earnings and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when INDPRO > 105.0, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.02.
